notes.sowing: Plant dormant crowns or divisions in early spring, as soon as the soil can be worked, with the buds just at soil level. Allow about {cm:90} each way, as clumps grow large.
notes.care: Choose full sun or light shade and rich, moist, well-drained soil. Mulch with compost each spring, cut out flower stalks as they appear, and divide clumps every 5 to 10 years. Rhubarb needs a cold winter rest and does poorly where winters stay mild.
notes.harvest: Take no stalks in the first season and only a few in the second. After that, pull stalks at full length for 6 to 8 weeks, stopping by midsummer. The leaves are toxic: trim them off and never eat them.
